Source: prix-carburants.gouv.fr, Open Licence. Search within 30 km of the route start, or map centre. Distances here are straight-line distances, not road detours. Pair your adapter in Android settings first and close other OBD apps. Standard sensors only; availability depends on the vehicle. This diagnostic session stops when you leave this screen.
